text: A March Walker is the quiet grazer of the March, a stocky, pig-shaped creature you will see in herds on the Steppe. It lives in every March biome but the Shallows, even the Ember Wastes.
It has **18 health** and **1 armour**. It is shy: it keeps about ten blocks from monsters and panics when hurt.
Hold a **Spirit Shard** and walkers wander after you, curious. That is the easy way to lead a few home or into a pen.
They spawn on March turf, soil, moss and snow, in open air.
A walker drops **1 to 3 Raw Game**, up to 2 March Leather and sometimes a bone, more with Looting; the meat comes roasted if it died burning.
Breed two with **wheat** or **Steppe Grain**, which they follow as readily as a shard. A walker cannot be brushed or bonded.
pages.title: Living with walkers
